newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - HANSA LIISING H1 PROFIT 44.4 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - HANSA LIISING H1 PROFIT 44.4 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Hansa Liising, the leasing arm of Estonia's leading bank Hansapank , had consolidated net profit of 44.4 million kroons in the first six months of the year, Hansapank said on Monday.
In June, its consolidated net profit was 10.2 million kroons compared to 8.5 million kroons the month before, it added in a statement.
Hansa Liising had a net profit of 36.2 million kroons over the six months.
Its Latvian subsidiary Hanza Lizings had a net profit of 5.6 million kroons while Lithuania's Hanza Lizingas saw a 1.9 million kroon profit in the first half of the year.
The group's consolidated assets reached 2.08 billion kroons at the end of June, after a growth of 10.2 percent in June and 63.6 percent over six months.
At the end of June, Hansa Liising Estonia's assets amounted to 2.014 billion kroons, Latvia's Hanza Lizings to 339.6 million kroons and Lithuania's Hanza Lizingas to 189.2 million kroons.
